question: To what energy demand (MJ per kg isoprene) did the process fall at the highest feed isoprene concentration studied?
rendered:
A Comparative Study of Forward Osmosis Systems: An Integrated Experimental, Modeling, and Techno-Economic Analysis, page 14
Process Simulation of Isoprene Recovery from Dilute Fermentation Off-Gas Using Absorption-Desorption, page 5

The process fell to 10 MJ kg−1 at the highest feed isoprene concentration studied, which was 4.3 wt %.
